items.title: How AI is enabling faster, more dangerous cyber warfare
items.summary: Refrigerator hacks. $6.3 billion crypto heists. 14-country espionage campaigns carried out in just 11 days. All in the span of a week.Why it matters: State-backed hackers are finding new ways to launch cyberattacks at remarkable speed and scale, with AI and automation threatening to widen the gap between attackers and defenders.Driving the news: Hackers tampered with refrigeration systems at dozen
